sloka: लक्ष्मणश्च महातेजाः सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः ।अभिवाद्य महाबाहुः स त्वां कौशलमब्रवीत् ।। ५.३४.३५।।।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇaśca mahātejāḥ sumitrānandavardhanaḥ ।abhivādya mahābāhuḥ sa tvāṁ kauśalamabravīt ।। 5.34.35।।।।

translations.english: "The brilliant, longarmed Lakshmana, delight of Sumitra enquires about your welfare and offers salutations to you.
